It has seen some action. Lots of it, in fact. Seems like it was worth holding on to. Now, freeze, dirtbag!

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3, can fire at ROF 2 at 2 different targets), Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear]. When this weapon inflicts a Critical Injury or deals 15+ HP damage in a single Attack, the target must make a DV15 Concentration Check or else also immediately suffer the Impair Movement Quickhack. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by sacrificing the user’s Move Action if they have one other free hand.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3, can fire at ROF 2 at 2 different targets), Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
